ABOUTME.TITLE: About Me
ABOUTME.INTRO1: I'm a full-stack developer focused on mobile development for Android, iOS, and cross-platform applications.
ABOUTME.INTRO2:
I'm a computer engineer specializing in software architecture, and a full-stack developer focused on mobile development for Android, iOS, and cross-platform applications, though I also build web applications with technologies like Ionic, working across both backend and frontend.
I strive to make my applications as accessible as possible, as this matters a lot to me, alongside applying the right architectures and design patterns.
I enjoy working with new, trending technologies like SwiftUI, but I also program in more established technologies. I believe it's important to understand both, as they will coexist for the time being.
I also handle application testing, and manage databases and microservices.
Starting September 2026, I'm expanding into Data Science and Artificial Intelligence with a Master of Science at CODA (Dijon, France), as part of my plan to build my career in the French tech market. If you'd like to learn more about my skills and projects, you can check out my Github

WHAT_I_DO.TITLE: What I do?
WHAT_I_DO.FULLSTACK: Full-Stack Development. Designing end-to-end applications with modern frontend frameworks and scalable backend — from database modeling to production deployment.
WHAT_I_DO.MOBILE: Mobile Application Engineering. Native and cross-platform development focused on performance, UX, and long-term maintainability.
WHAT_I_DO.ARCHITECTURE: Architecture & Code Quality. Clean architecture, SOLID principles, modular systems, and scalable design patterns.

ITEMS.BODY: Throughout the degree I worked across a wide range of languages and technologies — Java, C, C#, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, and Node.js among others — while building a solid foundation in software architecture, databases, and cloud computing. I also applied Scrum and Agile methodologies in team projects, which strengthened my ability to work collaboratively, communicate effectively, and manage my time and resources to deliver complex applications and systems.

This master's specializes in mobile application development across Android with Kotlin, iOS with Swift (UIKit and SwiftUI), hybrid apps with Angular and Ionic, and cross-platform development with React Native, combined with databases and cloud technologies. The program emphasizes staying current with emerging tools while applying clean architecture, scalable systems, and cloud-ready design — always with a strong focus on user experience and accessibility.

ITEMS.DEGREE: Master of Science AI & Data Science
ITEMS.BODY: Starting September 2026, I will be pursuing this Master of Science (Bac+5, French RNCP level 7 credential) specializing in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, covering machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision. The program is heavily hands-on, built around real company projects, with the option to complete it through a work-study track — allowing me to combine this specialization with direct professional experience in the French tech market.
